config_name: iPad Pro 13-inch — M5 (9-core CPU/10-core GPU), 12GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 13" Ultra Retina XDR tandem OLED + Magic Keyboard

specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard included in price: scissor keys (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total

battery.notes: Apple claims 10h web/video on Wi-Fi. Users report ~8-9h mixed real-world use.

price.notes: Bundle price = tablet (current best new retail) + keyboard, per the config definition. Components: Tablet-only $2,099.99 (BBY 19495714 / apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard 13" $449.99 (BBY 17932868). Apple Pencil Pro $168.99 not included.

offers.name: Bundle: tablet + keyboard (config price includes the keyboard). Tablet listing 2099.99 + keyboard per price.notes.

reviews.quote: An extremely fast M5 SoC and Wi-Fi 7. Pros: extremely fast M5 SoC, sturdy and timeless case, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G, good camera quality for a tablet, powerful speaker sound, comprehensive software package, good battery life, bright and accurate display. Cons: no power adapter included, very expensive, PWM flickering, no always-on display, only a 12-month warranty. (NBC review of the iPad Pro 11" M5 2025, 90% very good; same SoC and panel family across 11"/13" tiers.)

praises: Tandem OLED is the best display on any tablet — true blacks at 1000-nit SDR with 120Hz ProMotion (r/ipad long-term owners)
M5 benchmarks faster than most thin-and-light laptops in short bursts; huge GPU uplift over M4
Impossibly thin (~5.1mm) and light for a 13" — best 13-inch device Apple has built
Apple Pencil Pro hover + squeeze gestures are genuinely useful for drawing and markup
Thunderbolt port drives external displays and docks well in Stage Manager
complaints: iPadOS is the bottleneck: no full desktop-class apps (real Excel, Xcode, Ableton-class DAWs), file management friction — #1 Reddit gripe
Magic Keyboard at $449.99 with unlit keys feels like an accessory tax that pushes total near MacBook Pro money
Apple Pencil Pro sold separately ($168.99-199) on a $2,000+ device enrages buyers
256GB base feels small for a Pro at this price; upgrades are Apple-priced
Stage Manager external-monitor support still janky; single USB-C port and no headphone jack

design_philosophy: Apple's halo tablet: laptop-class silicon and the best tablet display ever shipped, in the thinnest Apple product to date, with iPadOS as the deliberate (and controversial) ceiling. This 256GB entry tier gets the full M5 experience at the lowest price, with storage — not speed — as the compromise. With the Magic Keyboard priced in it is Apple's answer to a ultraportable, minus desktop-app parity.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Pro M5 13" (90%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Anchor config for the line (see SHARED-ipad-pro.md).
